audiences.executive: Know about an incident before anyone outside does, and answer an auditor or a regulator with evidence, not estimates.
audiences.technical: Every environment sending the logs it should, detections that fire and are tuned, and the common responses automated, so an investigation takes hours, not weeks.
audiences.financial: Pay to keep the logs an investigation needs, not every log forever; fewer hours spent closing alerts nobody reads.

people: The analysts who handle alerts every day
The owners of the environments that send no logs
Compliance or audit, for how long logs must be kept

objections.says: We already collect all our logs.
objections.clarify: Which environments sent nothing during the last investigation, and how did you find out?
objections.answer: Collecting is not covering: check, for each environment, which sources are expected and which are missing, and alert when one goes quiet.
objections.prove: List the expected sources for three environments, and show an alert when one of them stops sending.

objections.says: Our analysts are drowning in alerts already.
objections.clarify: How many alerts were closed last month without anyone looking at them?
objections.answer: Fewer, better detections, and the common responses automated: the analysts look at what only a person can decide.
objections.prove: Take a week of alerts, automate the response to the most common one, and count the hours saved.

objections.says: Keeping logs longer costs too much.
objections.clarify: How far back did your last investigation, or your last audit, need to look?
objections.answer: Keep what an investigation needs searchable, and the rest in cheaper storage that can still be read when asked.
objections.prove: Answer one question about an event a year old, and show what keeping it cost.

objections.says: Moving to a new platform would leave us blind for months.
objections.clarify: Which detections would you need on day one, and which can follow?
objections.answer: Run both side by side, move the detections that matter most first, and switch over when they are proven.
objections.prove: Run the five detections you rely on most on the new platform beside the old one, and compare what they catch.
